problem:
Determine the graph of the following parametrically defined curve:

$$
x=1-2t,\,y=t,\,-3\le t\le 3
$$

feedback.problem:
Determine the graph of the following parametrically defined curve:

$$
x=t+1,\,y=1-t,\,-3\le t\le 3
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
We need to create a table of values and then sketch the curve. First, we work out the $x$-values using the formula $x=t+1.$ This gives

| **$t$** | $-3$ | $-2$ | $-1$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $-2$ | $-1$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ |
| $y$ | $$ | $$ | $$ | $$ | $$ | $$ | $$ |

$$

$$

Now, we work out the $y$ values using $y=1-t.$ This gives

| **$t$** | $-3$ | $-2$ | $-1$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $-2$ | $-1$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ |
| $y$ | $4$ | $3$ | $2$ | $1$ | $0$ | $-1$ | $-2$ |

$$

$$
